scenes.title: How to read the chart
scenes.say: Each bubble is one school. Further right means more study time, higher means better scores, and bigger bubbles have more students.

scenes.title: Ten years of change
scenes.say: Now watch ten years go by. Most schools drift up and to the right.

scenes.title: One school's path
scenes.say: Follow School E. Its dotted trail shows every year along the way.

scenes.title: Your turn
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Click Explore to play the years yourself.
